commit.merge_subject: merge: editor layout modernization phase one

description:
Editor layout modernization phase 1, second half (design review
2026-11-10): thin grade sliders with gradient axes, and the transport
restyled to match.

- CompactSlider: GradeSlider extracted to its own file with the same
  name, package, and parameters (plus a defaulted trackGradient), so
  the panel call sites compile unchanged. Visual restyle only: label
  left + tabular value right on one row, a 4dp track with a 12dp
  thumb, and the M3 Slider's own minimumInteractiveComponentSize keeps
  the ~48dp touch area while the line thins.
- Bipolar fill-from-zero: the active segment runs from the zero
  position to the thumb (negative fills left, positive right) with a
  zero tick, computed purely in EditorLayout.bipolarFill (JVM-tested).
  Unipolar sliders keep a plain min-to-value fill.
- Track gradients: Temperature blue-to-yellow, Tint green-to-magenta,
